legal_basis.value: C.R.S. 18-18-434 as enacted by SB23-290 (2023 Sess. Laws ch. 249): personal-use possession, consumption, sharing, cultivation and manufacture of natural (non-synthetic) DMT without remuneration does not violate state law; under-21 possession is a drug petty offense. DMT is Schedule I federally (21 CFR 1308.11(d)(19)).

access_pathway_details.text: Colorado law (C.R.S. 18-18-434, SB23-290) provides that a person who, for personal use and without remuneration, possesses, consumes, shares, cultivates or manufactures natural DMT does not violate state law; synthetic DMT is excluded. DMT is not part of the licensed healing-centre programme unless the Natural Medicine Advisory Board recommends it and state regulators approve it for inclusion on or after 1 June 2026. DMT remains Schedule I under federal law.

eligibility_requirements.text: Adults 21+; personal use without remuneration. Under-21 possession or consumption is a drug petty offense.

provider_requirements.text: The regulated healing-centre programme covers psilocybin and psilocyn; DMT can be added only on Advisory Board recommendation and state approval (not before 1 June 2026).

residency_travel_notes.text: The personal-use provision applies to any person and is not limited to Colorado residents; federal law still applies.

oversight_notes.text: Personal-use DMT falls outside the state's licensed cultivation, testing and dispensing system, which applies only to regulated natural medicine.

arbitrage_summary.text: Colorado decriminalises personal use of natural DMT for adults 21+; there is no licensed DMT therapy unless regulators add DMT to the programme. Federal Schedule I still applies.

access_pathway_details.text: Colorado law lets a person possess, consume, share or cultivate natural ibogaine for personal use without remuneration (synthetic ibogaine excluded). Ibogaine is not in the licensed healing-centre programme unless recommended by the Natural Medicine Advisory Board and approved by state regulators. HB26-1325 (signed 4 June 2026) creates an ibogaine research pilot in the Behavioral Health Administration, contingent on private gifts, grants and donations.

eligibility_requirements.text: Adults 21+; personal use without remuneration. Under-21 possession or consumption is a drug petty offense.

arbitrage_summary.text: Colorado decriminalises personal use of natural ibogaine for adults 21+; no licensed ibogaine treatment yet; a grant-dependent state research pilot was enacted in 2026. Federal Schedule I still applies.
